description: This Java source file defines the class TreeBasedPolicyEnforcer, which is an implementation of an access control enforcer that operates using a tree structure to manage policies, resources, and permissions. It includes methods to create policy trees, perform permission checks, and generate JSON views based on access rights, indicating it is a core component of the access control system within the project.

classes.name: PointerAndValue
classes.description: Immutable wrapper class holding a JsonPointer and its associated JsonValue, used internally for tracking elements within JSON structures.

classes.name: PointerAndPermission
classes.description: Immutable wrapper class pairing a JsonPointer with a specific permission string, used to track permissions associated with resource pointers.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new TreeBasedPolicyEnforcer from a given Policy, building a policy tree.

methods.name: hasUnrestrictedPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the specified subject has all permissions on a resource, regardless of specific policies.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPermission
methods.description: Returns the IDs of subjects who have the specified permissions on a given resource.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPermission
methods.description: Returns the subjects who have the specified permissions on a given resource.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Returns the IDs of subjects who partly have permissions on a resource, considering granted permissions.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Returns the subjects who partly have permissions on a resource.

methods.name: hasPartialPermissions
methods.description: Checks if there are subjects with partial permissions on a resource for the given permissions and authorization context.

methods.name: buildJsonView
methods.description: Constructs a JSON object representing a view of a resource, filtered by access permissions and JSON fields.

methods.name: collectFlatPointers
methods.description: Recursively flattens nested JsonFields into a list of PointerAndValue instances for easier processing.

methods.name: filterEntries
methods.description: Filters JSON fields based on granted and revoked resource pointers to produce a JSON view respecting permissions.

methods.name: extractJsonPointers
methods.description: Extracts JsonPointer objects from a collection of PointerAndPermission instances.

methods.name: getGrantedAndRevokedSubResource
methods.description: Calculates granted and revoked sub-resources for a given resource, type, subject IDs, and permissions.

methods.name: traverseSubtreeForPermissionAccess
methods.description: Recursively traverses the policy tree to determine permission access, populating granted and revoked resource collections.

methods.name: addPermission
methods.description: Adds permissions to collections based on EffectedPermissions for a specific resource during traversal.
